summary.text: Kimberly Welzenbach is the Republican candidate for Montana House of Representatives District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Denise Joy.
According to her Ballotpedia survey, she has led the Home Builders Association of Billings since 2015.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Kimberly Welzenbach was described as an executive with more than 40 years of experience in business development, executive management and government relations.

The response said she has been Executive Officer/CEO of the Home Builders Association of Billings since early 2015, previously served on the National Association of Home Builders EOC Board of Directors, and serves on the Montana Building Industry Association's Government Affairs Committee.
It also said she is Vice Chair of the City of Billings Interim Planning Commission.

Welzenbach's listed campaign messages included reducing regulatory burdens and taxation, eliminating Montana's Business Equipment Tax, eliminating property taxes for seniors and state income tax on Social Security, and prioritizing funding for first responders.
